Description.Value:
NEW CAMPAIGNS ONLY: adds three NEW, fully usable weapons - the Vulture PDW, the Vulture AR and the Vulture Sidearm - to the Phoenix base storage, ten of each with ten clips apiece.
Requires the ContentTool mod. Nothing to run: ticking this mod on publishes its model keys. Equip them, holster them, overwatch, reload and fire: stats, slots, ammo, sound and muzzle flash are cloned from a shipped weapon of the same class - PX_LaserPDW, PX_AssaultRifle and SY_LaserPistol - so each is held and fired on that class's own clips, with damage and spread retuned. The PDW and the AR wear this mod's own models; the Sidearm deliberately carries none and keeps its donor's art. NOTHING is written into your game files - the models are served from this mod's own bundle, and switching the mod off removes the weapons. NEW CAMPAIGNS ONLY: they are added to the starting storage, so an existing save will not have them. They cannot be researched or manufactured.
